title: Zoning map change for 47-03 108th Street, Corona
summary: This resolution approves, with modifications, a City Planning Commission decision to rezone property at 47-03 108th Street in Corona, Queens from R6B to R7D, with a C2-4 commercial overlay. The change would allow a new 13-story mixed-use building with about 119,500 square feet of space, including 119 apartments (30 income-restricted), plus commercial and community facility space. The Council held a public hearing on the application on July 21, 2026.
